scripts.dev: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages dev dist --port 8787
scripts.build:pages: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/_worker.js && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['icon.svg', 'icon.jpg', 'public/manifest.webmanifest', 'public/sw.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f.split(/[/\\]/).pop()));"
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:pages && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=photogramapp
